dialog.agent:
Veo 3 is paid-only, so I can’t run it on your current free-tier account—even with your approval of the quoted 80 credits.

I haven’t started a generation or spent any credits, and I won’t substitute another model. If you upgrade to an eligible plan, I can check the supported duration and rain-audio settings, then confirm the final cost with you before generating.

turns.agent:
I can’t submit a known paid-only model on your free account. Also, Veo’s supported durations don’t include exactly 5 seconds.

No credits have been spent. To keep **Veo only**, you’d need an eligible paid plan and a supported duration, with trimming to 5 seconds afterward.
